python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,os
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
p=Path('/home/moloch/semabi/docs/data/v4/transport/development/j1/evaluator/post_controls_adapter_v1/jobs/controls_v1/process.json')
v=json.loads(p.read_bytes());rows=[]
for label in ('runner_pid','child_pid'):
    pid=v[label];q=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
    row={'kind':label,'pid':pid,'present':q.exists()}
    if q.exists():
        try:
            stat=(q/'stat').read_text().rsplit(') ',1)[1].split()
            row.update(state=stat[0],pgrp=int(stat[2]),nice=int(stat[16]),affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(pid)))
            status=(q/'status').read_text().splitlines()
            row['status']=[s for s in status if s.startswith(('VmRSS:','Threads:','Cpus_allowed_list:'))]
            names={'BLIS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS','OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS','PYTHONHASHSEED','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE','PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX'}
            row['environment']={x.split('=',1)[0]:x.split('=',1)[1] for x in (q/'environ').read_text().split('\x00') if '=' in x and x.split('=',1)[0] in names}
        except FileNotFoundError:row['exited_during_sample']=True
    rows.append(row)
print(json.dumps({'sampled_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'job_status':v['status'],'processes':rows,'bytecode_prefix_present':Path('/tmp/semabi_j1_post_controls_v1_no_pyc').exists()},sort_keys=True))
PY
args.justification: Record host process ownership and resource settings for the authorized offline J1 controls.
